summary: Comprehensive test suite with excellent coverage of all task requirements: max-age, max-total-size, and keep-latest-N policies are all tested at unit, integration, and e2e levels. TDD methodology is clearly documented (tests marked 'written first (red)'). Strong fixture design with helper factory (New-MockArtifact), proper mock deleters, and deterministic reference dates. Good error-path coverage (missing fields, invalid JSON, negative values, deleter failures). Workflow structure validated including actionlint gate and act e2e pipeline. Main gaps: no tie-breaking tests (same CreatedAt), extreme boundary values untested (MaxTotalSize=0, very large artifact counts), and fixture file existence assumed rather than explicitly verified before BeforeAll. Dependencies on external fixture files could cause cascading failures if any are missing. Overall, the test suite demonstrates strong discipline and would catch most regressions effectively.
